Freight Carrier Usage Guidelines
TNT should only be used when large items cannot be shipped via any other approved carrier.

Aramex is to be used only when the customer is located in the same state as the dispatch location.

Capital Transport is a same-day taxi-style delivery service that can only be used within metro areas of the dispatching location. Customer Service must contact the customer to confirm a suitable delivery day before booking.

Australia Post and StarTrack can be used for shipments anywhere within Australia, as long as the parcel falls within the allowable maximum dimensions.

State-based rural freight providers (e.g. Morrows, PEP, Cochranes, Followmont, and Hunter Express) are preferred for regional or remote deliveries. These carriers can handle larger items that standard couriers cannot.

It's essential to book the correct provider, as different vehicle types are required depending on item size and destination.
